models_evaluated: eight text-to-image and text-to-video generative models (not named in the abstract)

links.outcome: Demographic and equipment representation in AI-generated depictions of Canadian medical radiation technologists versus workforce data
links.effect: Visible minorities 39% vs 20.8%; males 41.4% vs 21.2%; women 58.5% vs 78.8% (all p<0.001); younger age skew; 26% of outputs showed inaccurate or fictional equipment.
links.quote: AI depictions included a higher proportion of visible minorities (as defined by Statistics Canada) (39% vs. 20.8%, p < 0.001) and males (41.4% vs. 21.2%, p < 0.001), while underrepresenting women (58.5% vs. 78.8%, p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Evaluating demographic and equipment fidelity of generative AI images and videos of health professionals against workforce data

screen.reason: Evaluates demographic representation and equipment accuracy in text-to-image/video generative AI models depicting Canadian medical radiation technologists against real-world workforce demographics.
